rules.title: Purchase Card Data Segment is a Data Section 3 companion of Segment 100.
Purchase Card Data Segment object is required in the document being validated.
Segment Length is 3 digits representing the content length.
Purchase Card Data Segment max length is 86 alphanumeric characters.
Purchase Code is alphanumeric, max 16 characters, when populated.
PC Tax Amount is numeric, up to 7 digits with 2 assumed decimal places, when populated.
PC Freight Amount is numeric, up to 7 digits with 2 assumed decimal places, when populated.
PC Duty Amount is numeric, up to 7 digits with 2 assumed decimal places, when populated.
Ship-to Country Code is a fixed length of 3 digits, when populated.
Ship-to Postal Code format is PROVISIONAL (P-01): strict US ZIP+4 or general alphanumeric up to 10 characters; non-conforming values are flagged for SME review rather than hard-rejected.
Ship-from Postal Code format is PROVISIONAL (P-01): strict US ZIP+4 or general alphanumeric up to 10 characters; non-conforming values are flagged for SME review rather than hard-rejected.
Direct Marketing Invoice Number is alphanumeric, max 10 characters, when populated.

At most one Segment 104 per message. PROVISIONAL (P-02): not explicitly stated in the spec text the way Segment 101's cardinality is; enforced by analogy to the Data Section 3 slot structure pending SME confirmation.
